# Ambikly Documentation

> Official documentation for Ambikly, a WordPress eCommerce plugin. The free core sells physical
> products, digital downloads and variable products from one product table, one cart and one admin,
> with Stripe, PayPal and five offline payment methods, coupons, tax, shipping zones, customer
> accounts, invoices, a REST API, webhooks and WP-CLI. Ambikly Pro adds 35 add-ons on one license.
> Self-hosted on your own WordPress site. No transaction fees on any plan.

Documentation site: https://docs.ambikly.com
Product site: https://ambikly.com
Free plugin: https://wordpress.org/plugins/ambikly/
Full plain-text documentation: https://docs.ambikly.com/llms-full.txt

## Guide

- [Introduction](https://docs.ambikly.com/): Ambikly is a self-hosted WordPress eCommerce plugin for physical and digital products. Start here for installation, setup, and the full reference.
- [A tour of the admin](https://docs.ambikly.com/admin-tour): A map of every screen in the Ambikly admin — the sidebar groups, the header toolbar, each Settings tab, and where the Tools screen hides.
- [B2B companies & Net Terms](https://docs.ambikly.com/b2b-companies): Company accounts, credit limits, buyers and the "Bill my company" checkout option — how credit is reserved atomically, how terms set due dates, and how to record an invoice payment.
- [Blocks & store pages](https://docs.ambikly.com/blocks): The eight Ambikly Gutenberg blocks, every attribute with its type and default, what each one renders, and why they are server-rendered with no block-editor UI.
- [Cart & checkout](https://docs.ambikly.com/cart-checkout): How the Ambikly cart is stored and scoped, what checkout validates before payment, guest versus logged-in checkout, and the order that is created.
- [Categories, tags & brands](https://docs.ambikly.com/categories): How Ambikly organizes a catalog — hierarchical categories in their own table, the tag and brand taxonomies, assigning terms, and how each surfaces on the storefront.
- [Changelog](https://docs.ambikly.com/changelog): Current Ambikly and Ambikly Pro versions, requirements, the versioning policy, how updates reach a site, how the database migrates, and a safe update order.
- [Coupons](https://docs.ambikly.com/coupons): Create and manage Ambikly discount codes — the three discount types, every restriction and usage-limit field, how limits are enforced, and checkout failure messages.
- [Customers](https://docs.ambikly.com/customers): The Customers screen and customer record, saved addresses and the default-address rule, the storefront account area tab by tab, and how records link to WordPress users.
- [Digital downloads](https://docs.ambikly.com/digital-downloads): Sell files with Ambikly — shared files and pricing plans, download limits and expiry, the tokenized download endpoint, the customer Downloads tab and IP logging.
- [Emails](https://docs.ambikly.com/emails): The Emails screen, the four transactional emails Ambikly sends, the complete smart-tag table, every option key, deliverability notes, and how to preview and test.
- [FAQ](https://docs.ambikly.com/faq): Straight answers to the questions Ambikly store owners and developers actually ask — what works, what does not yet, and where each feature is documented in full.
- [Your first order](https://docs.ambikly.com/first-order): Place a test order through your own storefront using an offline payment method, verify the order, emails, invoice, stock and downloads, then refund or cancel it.
- [Your first product](https://docs.ambikly.com/first-product): Create one simple physical product and one digital product in Ambikly, covering only the fields that are actually required to publish each one.
- [Go-live checklist](https://docs.ambikly.com/go-live): Everything to verify before your Ambikly store takes real money — HTTPS, permalinks, live gateway credentials, tax, shipping, emails, backups, and the PayPal sandbox trap.
- [Import & export (CSV)](https://docs.ambikly.com/import-export): The Ambikly Tools screen — product and order CSV exports, the product importer, the full column reference, error reporting and the WP-CLI equivalents.
- [Installation](https://docs.ambikly.com/installation): Requirements, three ways to install Ambikly, what activation creates, how to add Ambikly Pro, and exactly what deactivating or deleting the plugin removes.
- [Inventory & stock](https://docs.ambikly.com/inventory): How Ambikly tracks stock — managed and unmanaged products, stock status, thresholds, the atomic decrement that prevents overselling, and the low-stock alerts.
- [Invoices & packing slips](https://docs.ambikly.com/invoices): How Ambikly generates invoices and packing slips, the token-guarded URLs, who can view them, PDF output, and the filters and actions for customizing both documents.
- [Orders](https://docs.ambikly.com/orders): The Orders screen, every order and payment status with its exact slug, the order detail view section by section, what a status change triggers, and order notes.
- [Payments overview](https://docs.ambikly.com/payments): All seven Ambikly payment gateways compared, how to enable and configure one, how credentials are masked, and why a subscription cart only offers Stripe.
- [Offline payment methods](https://docs.ambikly.com/payments-offline): Cash on delivery, bank transfer, check, manual payment and company net terms — what each is for, its settings, and the order status it produces.
- [PayPal](https://docs.ambikly.com/payments-paypal): Configure PayPal in Ambikly — the sandbox-by-default limitation you must fix first, credentials, the Orders v2 flow, the return URL, webhooks and refunds.
- [Stripe](https://docs.ambikly.com/payments-stripe): Configure Stripe in Ambikly — API keys, the Checkout Session redirect, the signed webhook that confirms the order, refunds, saved cards, and common failures.
- [What Pro adds](https://docs.ambikly.com/pro): Ambikly Pro is a second plugin that runs beside the free core with 35 add-ons on one license. The free-versus-Pro boundary, pricing, and exactly what a lapsed license does.
- [Install & activate a license](https://docs.ambikly.com/pro-install): Install Ambikly Pro beside the free core, activate your license key, understand each license state, and fix activation problems and paused add-ons.
- [Products](https://docs.ambikly.com/products): The Ambikly Products screen and the full product editor — every list column, filter, bulk action, tab and field, plus what each one stores and what it does not.
- [Refunds & cancellations](https://docs.ambikly.com/refunds): Full and partial refunds, which gateways return money, what happens to stock and customer totals, recording a net-terms invoice payment, and when cancelling restores stock.
- [Reports](https://docs.ambikly.com/reports): The four built-in reports — summary, sales by day, top products and status breakdown — what each measures, how date ranges work, and which statuses are excluded from revenue.
- [Reviews](https://docs.ambikly.com/reviews): Moderating product reviews in Ambikly — the Reviews screen, the auto-approve rule, verified-purchase detection, the storefront form and the public REST routes.
- [Roles & permissions](https://docs.ambikly.com/roles): Ambikly's two capabilities and two roles, exactly what Store Manager and Support Agent can reach, what stays Administrator-only, and how to assign a role.
- [Settings reference](https://docs.ambikly.com/settings): Every tab and every field on the Ambikly Settings screen, with its storage key, default and effect — including the areas that are present in the UI but not yet wired up.
- [Setup wizard](https://docs.ambikly.com/setup-wizard): Every step of the Ambikly setup wizard, the exact fields on each, what each one writes to the database, and how to configure the same things later from Settings.
- [Shipping](https://docs.ambikly.com/shipping): Ambikly shipping zones, regions and the three method types — how a zone is matched to an address, how each method's cost is computed, and what has no admin field.
- [Shortcodes](https://docs.ambikly.com/shortcodes): All eight Ambikly shortcodes with every attribute and default, the shop query strings for sorting, paging and filtering, and the AmbiklyStore bootstrap object.
- [Store pages](https://docs.ambikly.com/store-pages): The five pages Ambikly creates, the shortcodes on them, how slugs are recorded, why you sometimes get shop-2, and how to move or rename a store page safely.
- [Support](https://docs.ambikly.com/support): Where to get help with Ambikly, what to include so the first reply is useful, how to report a security issue privately, the refund policy, and what support covers.
- [System status](https://docs.ambikly.com/system-status): Where to find Ambikly's system status report, what every field in it means, what a bad value looks like, and what to send with a support request.
- [Tax](https://docs.ambikly.com/tax): Enable taxes in Ambikly, configure rate rows, and understand exactly how country, state, postcode, priority and compound rates are matched and applied.
- [Themes & template overrides](https://docs.ambikly.com/themes): What Ambikly can and cannot be overridden with. Three email templates support theme overrides; storefront markup is inline and customizable through CSS and filters only.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.ambikly.com/troubleshooting): Symptom-first fixes for the problems Ambikly stores actually hit — blank store pages, REST 404s, pending card orders, PayPal sandbox, missing emails, tax, shipping, jobs and webhooks.
- [Variations](https://docs.ambikly.com/variations): Build a variable product in Ambikly — attributes and values, generating combinations, per-variant price, SKU and stock, and how the storefront resolves a choice.

## Developer reference

- [Developer overview](https://docs.ambikly.com/developers/): How to extend Ambikly — the REST API, hooks and filters, webhooks, WP-CLI, the Pro Addon SDK, custom payment gateways and the durable job queue.
- [Addon SDK](https://docs.ambikly.com/developers/addon-sdk): The Ambikly Pro Addon base class, its settings schema and coercion rules, discovery and registration through ambikly_pro_addons, the license gate, and the shared durable job queue.
- [Database schema](https://docs.ambikly.com/developers/database): Ambikly's custom tables across its two schema owners, the migration mechanism and the shared version option, teardown on uninstall, and how to query store data safely with $wpdb.
- [Endpoint reference](https://docs.ambikly.com/developers/endpoints): Every REST route in the ambikly/v1 and ambikly-pro/v1 namespaces, grouped by resource, with the permission each one requires and the publicly accessible routes listed separately.
- [Hooks & filters](https://docs.ambikly.com/developers/hooks): Every ambikly_ action and filter in the Ambikly free core with its arguments and where it fires, plus the two dynamic patterns and the hooks the plugin documents but does not actually emit.
- [Payment gateway API](https://docs.ambikly.com/developers/payment-gateways): The PaymentGateway abstract class, the PaymentResult shape and its four factories, registering a gateway through ambikly_payment_gateways, and a complete working custom gateway.
- [REST API](https://docs.ambikly.com/developers/rest-api): Authentication, permission callbacks, the response envelope, body-only pagination, query parameters and error codes for Ambikly's two REST namespaces.
- [Template overrides](https://docs.ambikly.com/developers/templates): How ambikly_locate_template and ambikly_get_template resolve files, the three overridable email templates, and why the storefront, invoice and packing slip are customized differently.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.ambikly.com/developers/webhooks): Ambikly's nine outbound webhook events, the signed JSON envelope, HMAC-SHA256 signature verification in PHP and Node, and the retry, timeout and log-retention behavior.
- [WP-CLI](https://docs.ambikly.com/developers/wp-cli): Ambikly's three WP-CLI commands — upgrade-db, export and recompute — with every flag, which subcommand each applies to, and real examples.
